sources_read: .qc-cache/coldwater-strict-2026-10-02-r3/rules/WebDev Rubrics QC.xlsx (Quality Checks row 47, sheet row 48; Internal Quality Checks row 47; Deterministic Checks check-dockerfiles.py / check-pip-pinning.sh rows)

.qc-cache/coldwater-strict-2026-10-02-r3/rules/projects/webdev-task-template (task.toml, tests/Dockerfile, tests/test.sh, tests/tools/*, tests/scoring.toml, tests/.dockerignore, environment/Dockerfile)
evidence: Judge agent and model are pinned once, in task.toml:30-35 ([verifier.env] REWARDKIT_JUDGE=claude-code, REWARDKIT_MODEL=z-ai/glm-5.3-flashx, OpenRouter base URL, empty ANTHROPIC_API_KEY), byte-equal to the frozen block in staged-task-contract.md:66-71; the whole task.toml from [agent] down diffs empty against the frozen template. All five judge.toml files carry only the expected judge = "claude-code" fallback (line 2 of each) and no model key (grep for 'model =' under tests/ returns nothing). Judge CLIs and browser are pinned in tests/Dockerfile:17-22 (@anthropic-ai/claude-code@2.1.281, @openai/codex@0.151.0, @playwright/mcp@0.0.79, express@5.1.0, better-sqlite3@12.4.1), :32 (harbor-rewardkit==0.1.7) and :34-40 (Chromium installed by the Playwright CLI bundled in the pinned @playwright/mcp, so the browser build is fixed by that pin, and every judge.toml launches it via --executable-path=/usr/local/bin/chromium). Shared files tests/test.sh, tests/Dockerfile, tests/tools/score.py, tests/tools/restart_mcp.py, tests/scoring.toml, tests/.dockerignore and environment/Dockerfile are identical to the frozen template (diff --strip-trailing-cr), and their SHA256 values match manifest.json (e.g. tests/Dockerfile 72998ab8..., test.sh bd682592..., score.py 13de2b38..., restart_mcp.py 03c1426f..., task.toml 6d547769...). test.sh:207 runs rewardkit with --max-concurrent-agent 1 and installs nothing at grade time. Fixed clock: the task has no graded calendar/date rule. Every time-related requirement is a relative duration measured within the run (behaviour.md:5 five-second run budget, behaviour.md:11 library refresh within about five seconds; functional judge.toml lines 245, 263, 281, 290, 299, 362, 380 use two/four-second timers and 'within about ten seconds' windows with roughly 2x tolerance). server.js:71,84,111 stamps revisions with new Date().toISOString(), but no criterion grades a date or timestamp value, so the run date cannot move a graded figure. Not defects under this row: temperature and prompt-version markers are absent (explicitly not required), verifier network is public (explicitly not a defect), base images node:22-bookworm-slim / python:3.12-slim are tag-pinned without digest and apt packages are unversioned, both template-controlled (unpinned apt is a NOTE in check-dockerfiles.py). Counterexample search: a broken app cannot gain credit from the run date and a conforming app cannot lose credit from it, since nothing dated is graded; a conforming app that enforces the five-second budget exactly still meets the ten-second observation window. This is a static source finding; raw-evidence-index.json covers scripted golden behaviour only and no configured judge run was measured, which this row does not require. The private check-canonical-shared-files.py was not executed; template identity was established by diff.
